thread:
jules_peopleops: @here Planning a 'Small Victories' drop next Wed (May 14) to celebrate Q2 wins — quick, low-effort goodies: 1) personal enamel pin 2) single-serve pizza vouchers (local chains) 3) $5 e-gift card for remote folks. Goal is to ship to remote folks and do a small assembly + grab-and-go table at SF office. Need volunteers for: assembly (SF), delivery (NY), remote mailers pack & drop. Budget estimate in thread below.

devon_ops: count me in for assembly in SF, can help with lunch ops too. :raised_hands:

asha_retail: I can handle remote mailers (I ship 100+ packages a month for merch) — need dimensions and weight estimate. Also can source vegan GF pizza vouchers.

sam_leadeng: quick Q — are these taxable? if we do gift cards >$50 it's a different process. These look small but want to make sure comp/finance ok.

maria-finance: FYI from finance: <$100 per person in non-cash appreciation is fine, but we should keep receipts. $5 e-gift + small pin + voucher (~$12) is fine. Please route final vendor invoice to finance@redwood for cost center tagging.

jules_peopleops: thanks @maria-finance — plan is ~$18/person max. I'll attach the vendor quote once we confirm. Assembly plan: Tue 4pm SF (conference A) — we can do a 60–90min pack & sticker session. Delivery: Devon + 2 volunteers go to NY office Wed AM. Remote: Asha and 1 volunteer handle mailers Tue evening.

devon_ops: I'll bring tape + postal scale. Also we need labels for remote folks — can we get a CSV export of recent headcount + mailing addresses?

jules_peopleops: yes — @ops-bot can you export headcount/mailing list for active employees and add a column for office location?

ops-bot: Generated export: https://files.redwood/exports/exports_2045679999_headcount.csv (permission: people-ops, finance)

asha_retail: got it. I'll prep 120 mailer envelopes. Can we confirm kit contents so I can order bubble mailers?

jules_peopleops: kit contents (final draft): 
````
- enamel pin (1)
- $5 e-gift card (digital code printed on note)
- pizza voucher card (single-use)
- thank-you sticker + tiny note card with manager signoff
````
Please confirm allergies notes printed on card? maybe not needed.

maria-finance: Order under PO #PO-3091, charge to Cost Center 430-OPS. Vendor: BrightDrop Merch (quote attached). Finance will sign off once we have final headcount + invoice.

sam_leadeng: heads up — performance calibration week is Mon-Tue. Would it be awkward to send these the same week? Might be fine since it's celebratory not monetary bonus. Just flagging.

jules_peopleops: good point. We intentionally scheduled assembly Wed to avoid overlap. We'll avoid sending manager kudos in the same email as performance notes.

devon_ops: volunteers so far: devon_ops, liam_eng (mentioned in DM), tanya_ops (TBD). Need 2 more for SF assembly and 2 for NY delivery.

asha_retail: remote mailers volunteers: me + priya_eng. I can coordinate pickup of pins from mailroom on Tues 2pm.

jules_peopleops: action items: 
- @devon_ops confirm SF assembly volunteers by EOD Fri
- @asha_retail confirm mailer packaging list + bubble mailer count by Mon
- @maria-finance hold PO ready, waiting headcount
- @ops-bot export final headcount once signoffs done

jules_peopleops: RSVP form (please fill): https://forms.redwood/small-victories-rsvp — include dietary prefs and shipping address if remote. Also add volunteer role.

devon_ops: RSVP'ed (assembly). added GF option for pizza.

maria-finance: I'll approve PO when headcount is attached. Please cc finance.

jules_peopleops: Perfect. If we get >200 people we cap swag to first-come and consider digital-only for extras. Will post final logistics Monday morning. Thanks all! :sparkles::balloon:
